subject: Saltonstall Building Stormwater and Landscaping Revisions
overview: The commission reviewed and approved revised stormwater management and landscaping plans for the Saltonstall building project near the Mystic River. The approval includes requirements for an updated maintenance plan to ensure the survival of new native plantings and the functionality of drainage systems.

items.title: Commission Membership Recruitment
items.summary: Marie Izzo discussed ongoing efforts to recruit a new member for the commission and encouraged interested residents to apply through the city.

items.title: Saltonstall Building Stormwater and Landscaping Revisions
items.summary: Approved the revised plans for the Medford Housing Authority project with a condition requiring a detailed Operations and Maintenance plan for native plantings and stormwater systems. Discussion addressed bioretention areas near the Mystic River, native seed mixes for varying hydrology, and coordination with the DCR Clipper Ship Path project.

items.title: Administrative Business
items.summary: The commission deferred the approval of previous meeting minutes and discussed the upcoming meeting schedule for December and January.
